assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.
Bottom-row partition positions approximated as equal 3750mm quarter bays; the bottom dimension sub-chain was partly illegible at available resolution.
Bottom-row door positions approximated near room centers pending a clearer wall-support crop.
South-wall small window widths approximated as 1200mm centered per row pattern seen on South elevation.
Opening z heights are provisional pending elevation claim confirmation for the upper storey (z_floor=3.0, ceiling 3.6m).
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.

generation.notes: Deterministic plan partition compilation from explicit original-image pixels. Calibration and drawing fidelity remain unverified.

geometry_feedback.note: Effective declaration dimensions, not verified drawing dimensions. Bare world values mean metres. Compare with original annotations; no unit or scale is inferred.

unresolved: Bottom-row (B1-B4) partition and door exact pixel positions need a further magnified wall-support check against 2f_view.png before being treated as fully verified.
Upper-storey window/door head heights (currently 4.0-5.8/5.1 placeholders) need confirmation against North/South/East/West elevation chains for the 2F storey.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.
